issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按默认 150f 渲染，末挡后多出 15f 无意义的尾巴
画面上方压着调试标题 "JUMP CUT PUNCH-IN"，还和面包屑导航重叠
目标卡用 3px 灰色虚线框标记，读作调试辅助线而不是产品界面
放大走 transform scale，2.6x 末挡的文字边缘靠合成层放大
三挡之间除了跳变完全静止，平底无暗角，画面像三张截图
changes: 补 JUMP_CUT_PUNCH_IN_DURATION = 135；跳变帧 35/70、挡位 1.0→1.6→2.6、2f brightness 0.92 tick 全部保留
去掉调试标题；虚线框换成 UI 真实的选中态（强调色 1.5px 细环 + 5px 柔晕），第三跳"就是它"时 8f ease-out 加深一档
挡位倍率改用 CSS zoom 布局级放大（left = O/s − O 保持同 origin），2.6x 下 "1,284" 字边锐利
前两挡挡内 in-out 极缓漂移 0.8%，末挡 16f ease-out 推完后真静止 49f；漂移走 transform，跳变仍是零补间硬切
暗角随挡位收紧（0.10→0.14→0.18）把视线压向目标卡，全片叠 4.5% 颗粒
issuesEn: No exported duration, so the workbench rendered the default 150f with a meaningless 15f tail after the last step
A debug title "JUMP CUT PUNCH-IN" sat on top of the frame, overlapping the breadcrumb
The target card was marked with a 3px grey dashed box that read as a debug guide, not product UI
Magnification used transform scale, so text at the 2.6x step relied on compositor upscaling
Between jumps the frame was completely frozen on a flat background with no lens character, reading as three screenshots
changesEn: Added JUMP_CUT_PUNCH_IN_DURATION = 135; jump frames 35/70, steps 1.0→1.6→2.6 and the 2f brightness 0.92 tick are unchanged
Removed the debug title; replaced the dashed box with a real UI selection state (1.5px accent ring + 5px halo) that deepens over 8f on the third jump
Step magnification now uses CSS zoom (left = O/s − O keeps the same origin), so "1,284" stays crisp at 2.6x
The first two steps drift 0.8% on an in-out curve and the last step eases in over 16f, then holds still for 49f; drift uses transform so the jumps stay zero-tween hard cuts
Vignette tightens with each step (0.10→0.14→0.18) to pull the eye to the target; 4.5% grain across the shot
